title: Fuse P104 late delivery with residual cleanup for two actual consumers
body:
## Result

This source-bound fusion combines [PR #3981](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3981)'s actual copy-free late FULL delivery with [PR #3943](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3943)'s compressed query cleanup, using two actual correction consumers. It preserves all 280 input-column identities, endpoint rows and formal frames, and all 72 arbitrary dirty helper returns.

| Matched complete module | Before unit ADDs | After unit ADDs | Halves / doubles each | Native mass |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| [PR #3882](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3882) encoded correction | 5472 | **4704** | 2616 | **2520** |
| [PR #3940](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3940) fused source-preserving correction | 5856 | **5088** | 2712 | **2520** |

Each word saves exactly **768 unit ADDs**, with no extra scaling, native transport, private storage, or unpaid donor restoration. The source-preserving variant returns every X=x at FULL and every Y=x+y in its indexed hyperplane; it avoids the separate post-encoding adapter's extra192 native mass. These are matched constructive invoices, not scalar optima.

## Actual chronology and evidence

The original final416 query-cleanup events define D. Exact extraction verifies `D=T[I B]`, where T has 32 coefficients ±2. After the actual late deliveries and donor normalization are complete, `Q=h−Dx`. The [PR #3882](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3882) correction creates `q=x_J+B x_N` in persistent FULL residuals. In the [PR #3940](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3940) source-preserving tail, q exists at the exact internal cut after1360 tail operations excluding the already-paid104 lifts—after every scatter donor is restored and before the inverse pivot stream removes q. At either legal cut,64 read-only unit ADDs implement `Q+=Tq`, replacing832 old cleanup ADDs.

- A new exact Fraction evaluator runs the entire joined words on280 independent inputs and verifies actual cut rows, residual donors, FULL arithmetic availability, endpoint frames, and every dirty return.
- Each variant's complete chronological native transport subsequence is literally identical to its own matched reference. Prior native phase evidence and final physical/global/all-size qualifications remain inherited; no fresh native recipe audit is claimed.
- Eight actual semantic faults reject, including incorrect cleanup timing, an unrestored quartered donor, wrong source-consumption ordering, and source-preserving cleanup after q is destroyed.
- Seven actual optimized CLI corruption fixtures each pass a positive baseline before rejecting Boolean/float receipt values, duplicate keys, false savings, changed/missing source, or changed frozen predecessor bytes.
- Separate AI peer inspection and bounded reproduction passed; it reuses this evaluator and frozen builders, so it is not represented as a second independent implementation or human/formal review.

The unchanged conditional [PR #3954](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3954) two-axis gate still fails by32448. Scalar fusion changes no native quantity. New global caller hypotheses are separate tasks; there is no supplier admission, all-size theorem, selected-frontier change, or new kappa claim.

## Scope and provenance

Published fork head `fa933662771f241e6db5b70cdad571df8d8d14c0`, tree `6e25bd5ed638f936f11db953ffc42e0e81b9cbbb`. Exact committed bytes, source-history availability and official export integrity checks passed. All three registered commands passed from the read-only, Git-free official export, with unchanged bytes and permissions. Export SHA256: `1ff3430d59e34b65d0b5ddade1743de30aa73244a39f9699deca68b4ccc1fa91`.

Twelve files only under `research/p104-fused-late-cleanup/`, based on canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority 6. Four unchanged predecessor builder exports retain original Git blobs, SHA256 hashes and public heads: [PR #3981](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3981) `cdb7dcf3…`, [PR #3943](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3943) `2cba526a…`, [PR #3882](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3882) scientific `9d56eeed…`, and [PR #3940](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3940) `51ba88c0…`. The verifier authenticates original Git blobs as well as exact bytes; main-only exports require no unavailable unmerged history.

The full 702-open-PR body snapshot at 08:30:14UTC and a fresh latest100 update check found no equivalent fusion. The helper lacks a Discussion cache; the root coordinator separately checked live boards and posted the scoped claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3954#issuecomment-6263112891 . Main remained unchanged at the publication checkpoint. This is bounded overlap evidence, not a novelty certificate.

Credit Chris R / Clear1nsight's [PR #3981](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3981) late delivery, [PR #3943](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3943) cleanup/return adapter, [PR #3882](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3882) correction and [PR #3940](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3940) fused source-preserving tail. The new result is their verified coupled chronology and full matched bill. Credit Rohan Arun [PR #1972](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1972), Chafik Boukhalfa [PR #1991](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1991), Adam Gall [PR #1940](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1940), icekylinx [PR #531](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/531) and [PR #1862](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1862) compiler/interpreter lineage, and Josie Elliston, Sagar Thakrar, Douglas Colkitt and Dominik Scholz's E8/P104 work. [PR #3954](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3954)/[PR #3965](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3965) and the distinct [PR #3961](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3961)/[PR #3962](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3962)/[PR #3966](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3966) constraints remain credited. [PR #3956](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3956)'s existing adapter comparison is not claimed anew.

Prepared by Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No merge, closure, selected-frontier, or shared workflow change.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-fused-late-cleanup`. [Hosted CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39226011582) passes at the exact published head above: planning and all three registered replay commands succeeded, with committed inputs unchanged.
